dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid geometric narrowing is visible from the wide mid-body section toward a sharpened, triangular convergence at the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Localized asymmetrical bulging is present on the left lateral margin posterior to the midline, with a distinct jagged indentation on the right margin near the tail base.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; the visible dorsal area exhibits high-intensity normalized pixels consistent with adult depigmentation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A prominent, dark elliptical contrast disruption is visible on the dorsal surface of the head (melon). A secondary, smaller dark point is situated along the central dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A significant transverse indentation causing a visible shadow and geometric disruption is present across the mid-dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep, dark-pigmented lesion or puncture is visible on the head; a linear, shadow-casting scar or deep skin fold is visible on the right flank near the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: The dark, recessed feature on the anterior melon area serves as a primary unique structural marker.
